sequence_description: OIDC enterprise SSO: attempt to authenticate with an ID token that uses an attacker-controlled kid (JWKS key selection confusion). Broker must reject tokens not verifiable under the configured IdP trust anchor.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_kid_injection_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_kid_injection_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Broker accepted a token with attacker-controlled kid/untrusted signing key selection (JWKS kid confusion) instead of enforcing configured IdP trust anchor.

sequence_description: OIDC enterprise SSO nonce bypass: attempt OIDC SSO login where IdP omits nonce in id_token; RP must reject when nonce was sent.
description: OIDC SSO verify accepted id_token without nonce claim. The mock IdP omits nonce by default; per OIDC Core 3.1.3.7 §11, the RP must reject id_tokens with missing nonce when nonce was sent in the authorization request. Nonce validation bypassed.

sequence_description: OIDC enterprise SSO nonce bypass: attempt OIDC SSO login where IdP omits nonce in id_token; RP must reject when nonce was sent.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_oidc_nonce_bypass_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_oidc_nonce_bypass_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: OIDC SSO accepted id_token without nonce even though nonce should be required (OIDC Core 3.1.3.7 §11).

sequence_description: I3: OIDC SSO flow must be bound to the initiating request (nonce/state). Attempt login via OIDC SSO where IdP omits nonce; RP must reject (prevents callback splicing / step skipping).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_oidc_nonce_missing_attack_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_oidc_nonce_missing_attack_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: RP accepted an OIDC SSO login where nonce was omitted, indicating flow step skipping/callback splicing risk (nonce not enforced).

sequence_description: MFA coherence across auth methods: enable MFA factors on a victim user, confirm password login is blocked/challenged, then attempt SAML SSO login asserting the same email. If SAML login succeeds without MFA, flow coherence is violated (step skipping via alternate binding path).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_saml_as_victim_login_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_saml_as_victim_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SAML SSO login succeeded for an MFA-enabled account without completing MFA (alternate binding path skipped required step).

sequence_description: Unverified-email account linking via enterprise SSO (SAML connector): attacker claims victim email with email_verified=false; platform must not map attacker to victim account.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_sso_entity_id != user_victim_pwd_entity_id
Evaluation: user_attacker_sso_entity_id='elg76viwfmvv' != 'elg76viwfmvv' → False
Implication: Attacker SSO principal (unverified email) was mapped to victim's downstream identity (account takeover via unverified email linking)

sequence_description: SAML login with missing Conditions (no audience/time bounds) should be rejected; acceptance could allow overbroad authorization not bound to upstream intent.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_saml_nocond_attack_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_saml_nocond_attack_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted a SAML assertion without Conditions (no audience/time bounds), enabling authorization not bound to upstream intent/policy.

sequence_description: SAML brokered login authorization binding: attempt to authenticate with a forged SAMLResponse using a wrong IdP entity ID (Issuer) to see if Logto accepts assertions from an untrusted issuer (would over-grant a session). Includes a control SAML login first.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_saml_wrong_issuer_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_saml_wrong_issuer_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Logto accepted a SAML assertion with an untrusted/incorrect Issuer, granting a session beyond BrokerPolicy trust configuration (authorization binding failure).
